about: Where each outreach request stands, one row per company: drafted (desks/outreach/contact-requests/), requested (sent on this role's lane to conductor@web-summit.dinis, which drafts with what only it holds; a person sends), filed (the Web Summit team holds it as a draft in its private CRM), then sent or dropped with a date, as the public outcome comes back. Only public outcomes are written here, never an address or a reply (the comms protocol). Kept by outreach@PrompTugal.dinis; started 7 November 2026 after historian@'s brief board/briefs/2026-11-07-the-php-newsrooms-lesson.md (lesson 2: a draft never sent reaches no one).
